name: 40pcs Aiwa Socket Wrench Tool Kit | Durable Stainless Steel Multi-Purpose Repair Set
description:
The 40pcs Aiwa Socket Wrench Tool Kit is designed for home, garage, and professional use. Crafted from premium stainless steel, it delivers durability and resistance against wear, ensuring long-lasting performance. With 40 essential pieces including sockets, screwdriver bits, and wrench attachments, it covers a wide range of repair and maintenance tasks. Its compact, portable design makes storage and transport convenient, giving you the right tool whenever you need it.
Key Features:
 Premium stainless steel construction for durability
 40-piece complete set with sockets, bits & wrench
 Compact and portable for easy storage and carrying
 Multi-purpose use for home, garage & professional tasks
 Ergonomic design for comfortable and efficient work
How to Use:
 Select the appropriate socket or bit for the task
 Attach securely to the handle or wrench
 Apply steady force to tighten or loosen fasteners
 Store tools back in the case after use
Material:
High-Quality Stainless Steel, Plastic Storage Case
Safety Information:
 Use correct size tool to avoid damage or injury
 Keep out of reach of children
 Wear safety gear when performing heavy repairs
 Store in a dry place to prevent rust
Package Includes:
 1 × 40pcs Aiwa Socket Wrench Tool Kit with Storage Case
